title: 1988 AMC 8 Problem 22
statement: Tom’s Hat Shoppe increased all original prices by \(25\%.\) Now the shoppe is having a sale where all prices are \(20\%\) off these increased prices. Which statement best describes the sale price of an item?

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text: The sale price is \(5\%\) higher than the original price.

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text:
The sale price is higher than the original price, but by less
than \(5\%.\)

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text:
The sale price is higher than the original price, but by more
than \(5\%.\)

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: The sale price is lower than the original price.

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text:
The sale price is the same as the original
price.

solutions.text:
Increasing by \(25\%\) multiplies the price by \(1.25,\) and then taking \(20\%\) off multiplies by \(0.80.\)

The overall factor is \(1.25 \times 0.80 = 1.00,\) so the sale price equals the original price.

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: Increasing by \(25\%\) multiplies the price by \(1.25;\) taking \(20\%\) off multiplies by \(0.80\)
Multiply the two factors together and compare the result to \(1\)
